sloka: हुताशनं तर्पयतां ब्राह्मणांश्च नमस्यताम् ।आज्यगन्धप्रतिवहः सुरभिर्मारुतो ववौ ।। ६.५७.२२ ।।।।
transliteration: hutāśanaṁ tarpayatāṁ brāhmaṇāṁśca namasyatām ।ājyagandhaprativahaḥ surabhirmāruto vavau ।। 6.57.22 ।।।।

translations.english: A fragrant breeze blew past there with Rakshasas propitiating fire god, with offerings and by the worshipping of brahmins the air was pleasant filled with the fragrance of ghee and flowers.
